scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,KIOSK,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:kiosk" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix kiosk-app install && npm --prefix admin-app install
scripts.build: npm --prefix kiosk-app run build && npm --prefix admin-app run build
